[[File:Mom Hoenn ORAS.png|thumb|240px|The player's mother in {{g|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}}]] '''Mom''' (Japanese: '''おかあさん''' ''mother'') is the [[mother]] of {{ga|Brendan}} or {{ga|May}} and the wife of [[Norman]]. ==In the core series games== In {{game3|Ruby and Sapphire|Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire|s}}, {{v2|Emerald}}, {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby, and Alpha Sapphire}}, the player and their mother finish their move to [[Littleroot Town]] in a [[Inside of Truck|moving truck]]. She instructs them to set the [[time]] on the clock upstairs and to make sure that everything is on their desk. When the player comes back downstairs, she will say that [[Norman|the player's father]] is on TV; however, the player just missed him. When the player defeats [[Norman]], she will give an [[Amulet Coin]] as a reward. In Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire, after the player has entered the [[Hall of Fame]], a news report will be on TV. It will announce that a Pokémon is {{pkmn2|roaming}} the Hoenn region, which will be either {{p|Latias}}{{sup/3|Sa}} or {{p|Latios}}{{sup/3|Ru}}. In {{v2|Emerald}}, it will not distinguish which of the [[eon duo]] is the roaming Pokémon, due to static interference. Instead, the player's mother will ask if the news report was either about a red creature (Latias) or a blue creature (Latios). The one chosen will then roam Hoenn. In Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, Latias or Latios is encountered earlier in the game and no longer roams. Instead, after completing the [[Delta Episode]], she gives the player a [[Latiasite]]{{sup/6|OR}} or [[Latiosite]]{{sup/6|AS}}. In {{B2W2}}, Norman reveals that he and his family moved to Hoenn from [[Olivine City]]. ===Items given=== {{itlisth|normal}} {{Itemlist|Running Shoes|Given to the player before leaving on the journey|Ru=yes|Sa=yes|E=yes}} {{Itemlist|Amulet Coin|Given to the player after defeating [[Norman]]|Ru=yes|Sa=yes|E=yes|OR=yes|AS=yes}} {{Itemlist|Latiasite|Given to the player after completing the [[Delta Episode]]|OR=yes}} {{Itemlist|Latiosite|Given to the player after completing the [[Delta Episode]]|AS=yes}} {{itlistfoot|normal}} ==In the spin-off games== ===Pokémon Masters EX=== In [[Pokémon Masters EX]], she is {{mas|Norman}}'s wife and {{mas|Brendan}}'s mother. {{color2|000|Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire Versions|Ruby, Sapphire}}, and {{color2|000|Pokémon Emerald Version|Emerald}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Mom (Hoenn)/Quotes}} ==In animation== [[File:Caroline.png|thumb|250px|Caroline, mother of May]] {{main|Caroline}} In {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[Caroline]], {{an|May}} and [[Max]]'s mother, serves as her counterpart. She was introduced in ''[[AG003|There's no Place Like Hoenn]]'' and is married to [[Norman]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Ruby bedroom.png|thumb|200px|Ruby's mother in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:Hoenn mom.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ruby's mother in Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}==== {{adv|Ruby}}'s mother appears as a recurring character in this chapter. She and her son moved from [[Goldenrod City]] to [[Littleroot Town]] at the beginning of the chapter to live closer to her husband {{adv|Norman}} after he had been appointed as the [[Gym Leader]] of {{ci|Petalburg}}. She was left distraught after Ruby ran away from home soon after their arrival in order to participate in [[Pokémon Contest]]s against his father's will. ===Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire=== Ruby's mother appeared at the beginning of [[Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire (CoroCoro Comic)|Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire]], fulfilling the same role from the games. She arrived in [[Littleroot Town]] with Ruby in a [[Inside of Truck|moving truck]] and started to unpack furniture with {{p|Machoke}}. {{-}} ==Trivia== * In [[Pokemon Ruby and Sapphire]], a non-player character in [[Petalburg City]] mentions that [[Norman]] and his family are from [[Johto]]. In [[Pokémon Emerald]], the character who said this instead states that the player character's family moved from somewhere far away. In [[Pokémon Black and White Versions 2|Pokémon Black 2 and White 2]], Norman reveals that he is more specifically from [[Olivine City]]. In some new dialogue from [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]], the player's Mom also mentions that they moved from Johto. ** However, in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, they are from [[Goldenrod City]] instead. This was introduced in the manga prior to the reveal that they are from Olivine City in the games. ==Related articles== * [[Mother]] {{NPC|normal|hoenn=yes}} {{Project CharacterDex notice}} [[Category:Mothers]] [[Category:Female characters]] [[Category:Ruby and Sapphire characters]] [[Category:Emerald characters]] [[Category:Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters]] [[zh:妈妈（丰缘）]]
